rows.title: People per mapped building
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Calibration and ±20% range; not a household census. The ±20% is ASSUMED.

rows.title: People per catchment
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Urban producer weight reduces this effective population. This is not a literal headcount of everyone living there.

rows.title: Potato production per person
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: 2024 Season A district area × yield share scaled to annual national total, divided by 2022 census. Not a directly observed district annual total.

rows.title: Local production multiplier
rows.label: ASSUMED
rows.why: Each site gets its own existing draw. Shared production scalars alone do not reorder sites.

rows.title: Rainy-season access factor
rows.label: ASSUMED
rows.why: Earth/path .45; unknown minor .6; gravel .7; untagged major .85; paved .9; off-network walk ×.8. Scenario comparison, not sampled by the 300 draws.

rows.title: Dry road speeds
rows.label: ASSUMED
rows.why: Mapped highway class selects speed. Walking 4 km/h, distance ×1.3; snap within 3 km, direct walk within 4 km.

rows.title: Crop loss rate
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.why: No loss-rate parameter exists in the shipped model. Do not imply zero loss or avoided losses. FAO discusses loss mechanisms, not a Nyabihu rate.

rows.title: Ambient temperature
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: ERA5 reanalysis at district centre; not measured at a site. Frozen raw daily values retained.

rows.title: Pull-down cooling load per tonne
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Thermal load, not electricity. Divide by COP to estimate electrical pull-down.

rows.title: Holding electricity per tonne-day
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Derived holding load / COP; excludes intake pull-down. Input ranges are ASSUMED.

rows.title: Peak-day electricity
rows.value: (intake × cp × ΔT / 3.6 + stored × holding load) / COP
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Intake = annual catchment tonnes × capture share × type multiplier × peak-month fraction / 30. Stored = intake × storage days. 30 days/month is an accounting convention.

rows.title: Running electrical power
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Average while running; not measured peak motor-start or connection capacity.

rows.title: Illustrative PV size
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Does not include batteries, night-time load or a system design.

rows.title: Rank and stability
rows.label: ESTIMATED
rows.why: Robust ≥80%; Contested ≥40%; otherwise Check first when more than 10 sites. These shipped thresholds are ASSUMED, not calibrated probabilities.

rows.title: Siting percentile
rows.label: PREDICTED
rows.why: Upstream footprints, roads, grid and settlements only. Separate from energy ranking.

rows.title: Location, roofs and mapped grid
rows.label: DOCUMENTED
rows.why: Mapped geometry or derived distances/roof area; not surveyed or evidence of operating refrigeration. Buildings can predate the release by years.

rows.title: Evidence workflow counts
rows.value: count of complete, structurally valid records
rows.label: DOCUMENTED
rows.why: DOCUMENTED is a source record; PREDICTED is a model output. DESK-CHECKED counts named imagery reviews. PHONE-CHECKED counts completed calls including misses. Neither is field validation. Initial human counts are zero.
